              SET "employer" = COALESCE(?1, "employer"),
                  "premium" = COALESCE(?2, "premium"),
                  "deductibleLimit" = ?3,
                  "oopmLimit" = ?4,
                  "metadata" = COALESCE(?5, "metadata"),
                  "updatedAt" = ?6
            WHERE "id" = ?7
